name: MCS_EXIT
meaning: cancel requested: clear cache, result CANCELLED, fade out

name: MCS_FADE_IN
meaning: g_mcardFade 15 -> 0, one step per call, then DETECT

name: MCS_DETECT
meaning: 'looking for saved game'; waits for the delay, queries the card status (0x65 FORMAT_Q, 0x67 OPEN, 0x68 DAMAGED, else NO_CARD)

name: MCS_OPEN
meaning: open registry root; mode 1 goes to READ_LOAD, otherwise READ_SAVE. In autosave the image must read OK with a matching timestamp, then WRITE

name: MCS_READ_LOAD
meaning: 'loading data...': read image; OK -> CHOOSE_LOAD, 0x322 -> CORRUPT

name: MCS_CREATE_Q
meaning: 'would you like to create a save file?'

name: MCS_CONFIRM_SAVE
meaning: 'Are you sure you want to save this game?'

name: MCS_CONFIRM_OVERWRITE
meaning: 'are you sure you want to overwrite this game?'

name: MCS_NEW_GAME_NO_AUTOSAVE_Q
meaning: 'start a new game? automatic save off.'

name: MCS_FINISH_LOADED
meaning: saveSlot, saveSlotValid and autoSaveOn, saveTimestamp = image timestamp, DONE

name: MCS_AUTOSAVE_CORRUPT
meaning: 'Data may be corrupt! Autosave disabled.' result FAILED
